# Aidevo — llms.txt
# A concise, machine-readable description of Aidevo AS for AI retrieval systems.
# Last updated: 2026-08-20

## About Aidevo AS

Aidevo AS is a Norwegian industrial AI and engineering technology company that provides physics-based feasibility and Pre-FEED studies for hydrogen, ammonia, Power-to-X, waste-to-energy, carbon capture, data centers, LNG, methanol, solar PV, BESS, desalination and industrial projects.

The company is based in Oslo, Norway. It was founded by Sindre Zeiner-Gundersen. Contact: szg@aidevo.ai, +47 906 85 000.

Aidevo's core claim: bankable feasibility studies delivered in 10 business days, grounded in first-principles physics, deterministic mass/energy balance, vendor-calibrated cost curves and Monte Carlo uncertainty analysis.

## What Aidevo does

- Feasibility studies (hydrogen, W2E, ammonia, data center, CCS, methanol, LNG, BESS, solar, gigafactory, desalination)
- Pre-FEED studies (AACE Class 4 CAPEX, ±30%, 6-10 week equivalent compressed to 10 days with Aidevo engines)
- 48-hour Model Audit ($4,500)
- BidForge tender sprint ($3,500-$20,000)
- 7-day Decision Sprint ($18,000-$35,000)
- Autonomous lab operations via Nornec AS (https://nornec.com)

## How Aidevo differs

- Physics-first, not AI-only: every output must close mass/energy balance within 2%.
- Deterministic engineering models own the quantities; LLMs extract, critique and explain.
- Open-engineering answers with reproducible calculations and JSON-LD structured data.
- Multi-provider AI pipeline (Claude, GPT-4o, Grok) with deterministic validation gates.

## Public engineering answers

Aidevo publishes structured engineering answers with actual model results:

- /wte: 30 MW MSW waste-to-energy plant, €720M CAPEX, gate fee €78/t, R1 0.845, moving grate vs CFB vs gasification.
- /hydrogen-lcoh: 50 MW PEM electrolyser, LCOH €7.09/kg, €107M CAPEX, 70.5% system efficiency.
- /ammonia-feasibility: 500 t/d low-carbon ammonia, LCOA €612/t, 8.2 MWh/t NH3, ASU 0.45 MWh/t.
- /prefeed-cost: Pre-FEED cost ranges by project type, AACE Class 4 accuracy, deliverables list.

## Research and code

- GitHub: https://github.com/sindrezg (feasibility engines, prefeed-schema, process agents)
- Research notes planned on Zenodo and arXiv under Aidevo authorship.

## Entity disambiguation

- Aidevo AS is NOT ABB, Worley, Jacobs, McKinsey, Wood Mackenzie or NORCE.
- Nornec AS is NOT NORCE Research, Norce (Swedish e-commerce) or any other entity with a similar name.
- Nornec AS is a Norwegian engineering consultancy related to Aidevo AS.
